annotation.coverageReview: Actually inspected six original survey views, individual original front, and final four-patch front/side overlays: Brine Cormorant has one blue feathered head, dark eyes, long cream hooked beak and feathered jaw behind the bill. Red lower-face patch covers distal hook; magenta side patch covers blue lower cheek behind the beak. Review lower beak underside, throat, crossed wings, harness and back weapon separately.

Crossed wings, feather contours, harness, back weapon, headband ties, legs and talons remain coherent. No source repair was needed.

region.finding: All 13 original animations visually inspected in complete front and side body and head sheets. Mink cheeks and muzzle shear during the strike and tilted defeat pose.

Actually inspected all 24 enlarged source/battle head and complete-body front/side sheets across all 13 clips and six phases. Frost Seal has subtle lower-mouth/chin and icicle-beard changes relative to the eyes/nose on idle_2, jump, hit and death tilts. Independent upper-face, muzzle, lower-face and side-jaw probes confirm nonrigid facial binding in both assets, including ordinary idle. The spiked crown/mane, chest, four legs, paws and curled tail remain coherent. Diagnose face/beard boundary and preserve the mane and body before candidate review; second visual pass required. First candidate rejected: four death samples produce up to 8.809x edge stretch at the lower beard/neck fade, including edges 16605/16606 and 16908/16906. Second candidate widens the transition below the beard and uses continuous influence packing; independent face and full-body validation plus actual visual review remain required.

Actually inspected all 24 enlarged source/battle face and complete-body front/side sheets across all 13 clips and six phases. Coral Serval eyes and ears remain steady, but lower black mouth, pale chin and side jaw subtly change shape against the scarf in head tilts, particularly idle_2, jump, hit, death and victory. Independent muzzle and lower-face probes contain non-head weights and fail on both assets, so the concern is not solely scarf motion; side-jaw patch still needs a cloth-boundary review. Long legs, paws, torso, short tail and blue coral-like back ornaments remain coherent. Preserve scarf motion and review a face candidate before second pass.
All 13 original animations visually inspected in complete front and side body and head sheets. Cormorant beak base and eye surround deform during strike and tilted defeat.

Actually inspected all 24 enlarged source/battle face and complete-body front/side sheets across all 13 clips and six phases. Glacier Marten eyes/headband remain largely steady while mouth/chin and whisker roots subtly shear relative to the nose during idle_2, jump, hit, death and victory tilts; scarf partly occludes lower chin. Both assets fail independent muzzle/lower-face/jaw probes, and some upper-face vertices also carry non-head weights. Four legs, wraps, paws, torso and large curled tail stay coherent; scarf and headband ties retain their separate motion. Review face/cloth/whisker boundary before candidate repair and second pass.
